title: Comprehensive Guide on Purchasing Software
summary: Discover the best guide to purchasing software for hardware-centric startups and mid-size companies,
body_text: Do You Need a Procurement Solution for Your Business? ‍ Traditional procurement often struggles with manual processes, such as excessive paperwork and slow approvals, leading to errors. This can impact delivery times and financial stability. Companies, especially those with department heads overseeing large-scale hardware purchases, should recognize these issues to determine the need for an advanced procurement automation software . ‍ Benefits of a Procurement Management System Streamlined Ordering Process Simplified Procurement: eProcurement software simplifies the entire procurement process, from initial request to final purchase. This streamlined approach reduces the time and effort required to place and process orders. Improved Accuracy: By automating order entries, the chances of errors commonly associated with manual processes are significantly reduced, ensuring more accurate procurement operations. Automation of Key Processes Reduced Manual Workload: Automated processes eliminate repetitive manual tasks, freeing up staff to focus on more strategic aspects of procurement. Consistency and Compliance: Automation ensures that procurement activities are consistent and compliant with internal policies and external regulatory requirements, reducing compliance risks. Faster Approval Workflows Efficient Approvals: eProcurement systems often come with customizable approval workflows, speeding up the decision-making process without compromising control. Real-Time Tracking: Stakeholders can track the status of requisitions and approvals in real-time, enhancing organizational transparency and communication. Enhanced Process Efficiency Time and Cost Savings: By streamlining procurement processes, companies can significantly reduce the time and costs associated with purchasing activities. Data-Driven Decisions: eProcurement software provides valuable insights into procurement data, enabling businesses to make informed decisions that improve efficiency and effectiveness. Improved Vendor Management Better Supplier Relationships: The system allows for more effective communication and collaboration with suppliers, leading to stronger relationships. Vendor Performance Tracking: Companies can monitor and evaluate vendor performance, ensuring they meet contractual obligations and delivery times. Cost-Effective Procurement Alternatives Reduced Procurement Costs : Automation and streamlined processes lead to lower operational costs, offering more cost-effective procurement solutions. Strategic Sourcing: The system enables businesses to identify and collaborate with suppliers that offer the best value, not just the lowest price. Contribution to Financial Stability Budget Management: Enhanced visibility into spending and cost-saving opportunities helps in better budget management. Risk Mitigation: By providing a clear overview of procurement activities, eProcurement software helps in identifying and mitigating financial risks. eSourcing vs. eProcurement: What’s the Difference? eSourcing helps you find and assess suppliers online, ensuring they meet your technical and operational needs. eProcurement is the process of buying goods and services online, often integrating with accounting systems to ensure compliance. Why They Matter Both eSourcing and eProcurement make purchasing easier by expanding supplier options, reducing paperwork, and improving transparency. They also help businesses stay compliant with regulations and manage purchase orders more efficiently. How Purchasing Software Helps Purchasing software streamlines both eSourcing and eProcurement. It speeds up approvals, improves vendor management, and automates key processes,saving time, cutting costs, and reducing risk. ‍ ‍ Is Spend Management Software the New Procure-to-Pay Software? Understanding the Procure-to-Pay Cycle The procure-to-pay cycle encompasses all the steps involved in acquiring goods and services, from requisition to final payment. It includes activities such as supplier selection, order placement, invoice processing, and payment. The Role of Spend Management Software in the Procure-to-Pay Cycle Spend management software provides comprehensive functionality throughout the procure-to-pay cycle. It streamlines and automates various stages, including requisition management , supplier evaluation, purchase order processing, invoice reconciliation, and payment tracking. By utilizing spend management software, high-level executives can achieve end-to-end process optimization, improved efficiency, and better cost control. ‍ Who Can Use This Software? Any business can use spend management software, but it’s especially helpful for companies that buy a lot of supplies or equipment. These businesses often have complicated purchasing processes, and this software makes it easier by automating tasks, saving time, and reducing costs. ‍

title: Greenville Plant Recognized as Environmental Steward
body_text: Greenville Plant Recognized as Environmental Steward Following a rigorous evaluation, the NC Department of Environmental Quality honors HYMH plant for its sustainability initiatives. October 28, 2025 Hyster-Yale Materials Handling has been recognized by the State of North Carolina as an Environmental Steward , following a rigorous evaluation by the state’s Department of Environmental Quality and the advisory board of the Environmental Stewardship Initiative (ESI). This prestigious designation honors a wide range of sustainability initiatives at Hyster-Yale’s Greenville, NC manufacturing plant aimed at minimizing environmental impact. Prior to this “Steward” recognition, the Greenville plant had been a “Rising Steward” for 20 consecutive years, making this acknowledgment a true honor. Hyster-Yale and its facilities take sustainability seriously. Over the last decade, the company has committed to reduce VOCs, carbon emissions and hazardous waste by 30%, lowering water consumption by 20%, and achieving zero waste to landfill and striving for a worker injury rate of zero. To meet these results and earn the Environmental Steward designation, the company has implemented several impactful initiatives, including: Sustainable water treatment: Replacing chemical treatments in the facility’s cooling tower with a moss-based solution, significantly reducing water usage and wastewater production. Energy-efficient lighting: Transitioning from fluorescent to LED lighting, enhancing facility brightness while significantly cutting energy consumption . Employee-driven air leak detection: Launching an engagement initiative to identify leaks in the plant’s compressed air system — nearly 100 leaks were found in 2024, and 150 more were found and fixed in 2025, each typically saving ~$1,000 in wasted energy costs per year. Real-time safety/environmental reporting: Empowering employees to report risks, hazards, ideas, or suggestions via QR code, enabling swift resolution by facility management. To further encourage local sustainability efforts, Hyster-Yale has partnered with the East Carolina University (ECU) Center for Sustainability and Environmental Engineering to host events, present sustainability projects and establish internships, which support the educational aspect of being an Environmental Steward. As part of this intern program, interns have played a key role in identifying opportunities for the Greenville plant to advance sustainability initiatives, leading directly to several of the projects recognized by the state. “This recognition is a tremendous accomplishment for our entire team and underscores our unwavering commitment to responsible corporate citizenship and a positive community impact,” says Danny Owens, Plant Manager, Hyster-Yale Materials Handling. “In a state with more than 275,000 business eligible for this honor, to be just the 31st to achieve this designation, further demonstrates the strength of our environmental leadership.” The Greenville plant was previously honored with the Carolina Star designation by the North Carolina Department of Labor – the highest safety recognition in the state, which recognizes employers and employees for effective safety and health management systems, as well as injury and illness rates. This recognition was recertified in 2024, following awards from the NC Department of Labor for 4 million hours without a lost-time injury and five consecutive years of incident rates below 50% of the industry average. This latest honor makes Hyster-Yale now one of only six business in North Carolina to hold both the Environmental Steward and Carolina Star titles simultaneously. “At Hyster-Yale, we evaluate ourselves on a holistic scorecard that places environmental stewardship and safety alongside more traditional business metrics like manufacturing efficiency and cost,” said Stephen Kelly, Senior Environmental Health and Safety Manager, Hyster-Yale Materials Handling. “This recognition reflects our deep commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen, and we’re ready to keep improving.” Looking ahead, plan leadership plans to expand the LED lighting conversion, optimize the HVAC systems, and share best practices across sister sites to help further reduce environmental impact company-wide. title: Austin Gold Advances U.S. Exploration with New Geophysics and Drilling Plans
summary: Austin Gold Corp. was founded in 2020 to focus on gold exploration in Nevada. The Austin Gold team has been instrumental in building several mining successes in the past, including Pretium (“PVG”), SSR Mining (“SSRM”), and Uranerz Energy (acquired by Energy Fuels “UUUU”). Two of those mining companies have multi-billion-dollar market capitalizations.
body_text: October 1, 2025 Summary At Stockade Mountain, a Controlled Source Audio-frequency Magnetotellurics (“CSAMT”) survey has been designed to better target high grade gold vein structures at the appropriate depth and will be completed this year subject to contractor availability and weather and ground conditions. At Lone Mountain, the Company continues detailed field work that includes geological mapping, geochemical sampling, and additional gravity geophysics. Soil sampling results show significant enrichments of arsenic, antimony, and thallium over large areas of the property that are associated with gold anomalies. Vancouver, BC, Canada — Austin Gold Corp. (“Austin” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AUST) provides an update on its exploration activities at its Stockade Mountain Project in Oregon, and Lone Mountain project in Nevada. Project Update At the Stockade Mountain Project , an in-depth review and modeling of a historical gradient-array IP-resistivity survey suggests that it was not suitable for imaging potential vein-hosting structures at the depths of 200-300 metres, which are the target depths for this project. Accordingly, the Company has designed a detailed geophysical CSAMT survey to acquire better imaging of target structures. The Company is in the queue with a contractor for this survey and expects it will be completed this year, subject to weather and ground conditions. The reverse circulation (“RC”) drilling program anticipated for 2025 is being deferred until 2026 to allow incorporation of the CSAMT results into drill targeting. The Company has received permission from the Oregon Water Resources Department to drill a water well to produce water for exploration drilling and is planning to drill the well in the fourth quarter of 2025 to ensure water is available for future drilling campaigns. At the Lone Mountain Project , the Company continues to advance exploration with detailed geological mapping, geochemical sampling, and gravity geophysics. As previously reported, Austin completed a soil and stream sediment sampling program consisting of 2,027 soil and 122 stream sediment samples. Further analysis of data from the 2024 soil sampling program revealed unusual patterns for a few of the elements that are not normally used for Carlin-type gold deposit exploration. Re-assay of the samples has been completed with minimal overall change in the elements useful for Carlin-type gold deposit targeting. These results show significant enrichments of arsenic, antimony, and thallium over large areas of the property that are associated with gold anomalies in the soils up to 0.128 g/t. The Company is in the process of incorporating the soil results with the detailed geological mapping and gravity geophysics surveys. Although significant historical exploration has been conducted at Lone Mountain, large areas of the property remain untested, or minimally tested, by drilling. Robert M. Hatch, the Qualified Person for Austin as defined by National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects, has approved the scientific and technical information in this news release. Corporate Update – Marketing Agreement On September 26, 2025, the Company entered into a marketing agreement with i2i Marketing Group, LLC (“i2i”), a Florida-based company, for the purpose of providing various marketing services to the Company. i2i will create an advertising campaign and utilize their marketing program strategy with the aim of increasing investor awareness through various online platforms and methods of engagement. The agreement has an initial term of two months at a cost of $250,000. The Company will not issue any securities to i2i as compensation for its marketing services. As of the date hereof, to the Company’s knowledge, i2i (including its directors and officers) does not own any securities of the Company and is arm’s length to the Company. About Austin Gold Corp. Austin is a gold exploration company focused on gold targets and making district-scale gold discoveries in the southwestern United States. Austin has two projects in Nevada. The Kelly Creek Project is located on the Battle Mountain—Eureka (Cortez) gold trend in Humboldt County and the Lone Mountain Project is on the Independence-Jerritt Canyon gold trend in Elko County. Collectively, these Nevada properties comprise approximately 34.9 mi2 (90 km2) of unpatented lode mining claims and private property. In Oregon, the Stockade Mountain Project consists of approximately 10.5 mi2 (27.2 km2) of unpatented mining claims situated in a geological environment that appears the same as the nearby Grassy Mountain Deposit that is being permitted for underground mining. title: Sono-Tek Wins $2.8 Million Order for Advanced Medical Device Coating Systems
summary: MILTON, N.Y., Oct. 13, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Sono-Tek Corporation (Nasdaq: SOTK), the leading developer and manufacturer of ultrasonic coating systems, today announced that it has received a purchase order valued at over $2.8 million from a major U.S.based medical device manufacturer. This order, placed by an existing customer which is ramping up production, includes…
body_text: MILTON, N.Y., Oct. 13, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Sono-Tek Corporation (Nasdaq: SOTK), the leading developer and manufacturer of ultrasonic coating systems, today announced that it has received a purchase order valued at over $2.8 million from a major U.S.based medical device manufacturer. This order, placed by an existing customer which is ramping up production, includes multiple advanced ExactaCoat MD (Medical Device) systems. The ExactaCoat MD systems include expanded capabilities compared to Sono-Tek’s previously supplied equipment. These new systems will be installed in addition to the customer’s existing Sono-Tek coating equipment, which will remain in production use. Deliveries of the new equipment are expected to begin in the beginning of calendar year 2026 and be completed within the first half of 2026. Steve Harshbarger, President and CEO of Sono-Tek, commented: “This award highlights the continued trust leading medical device manufacturers place in Sono-Tek as they scale production of innovative healthcare technologies. The addition of these higher-capability systems, complementing the Sono-Tek equipment already in use at this facility, underscores the value of our long-term customer relationships and the scalability of our coating platforms. Importantly, this order comes from a different customer than the $5 million medical device order we announced last month, further broadening our base of high-value opportunities.” This win reinforces Sono-Tek’s strong position in the medical device sector, a critical growth driver in the Company’s long-term strategy, and underscores its ability to capture repeat, multi-million-dollar orders from multiple leading manufacturers across the industry. title: Dave & Buster's abre su primera ubicación en Filipinas en Opus Mall
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Dave & Buster's, el destino líder mundial en comida, bebidas y entretenimiento, ha inaugurado oficialmente su primera ubicación en Filipinas,...
body_text: El evento marca la primera de varias ubicaciones planificadas en todo el país MANILA, FILIPINAS , 16 de octubre de 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Dave & Buster's, el destino líder mundial en comida, bebidas y entretenimiento, ha inaugurado oficialmente su primera ubicación en Filipinas, en el cuarto piso de Opus Mall, en asociación con The Bistro Group, el principal grupo de restaurantes del país. La sede de Manila representa un hito importante en la expansión global de Dave & Buster's y presenta la experiencia insignia de la marca: Eat. Drink. Play. Watch. — trayendo por primera vez a Filipinas un concepto de entretenimiento estadounidense único. Los invitados pueden esperar: Continue Reading Dave & Buster’s Opens First Location in the Philippines at Opus Mall EAT (Comer) – Un menú irresistible de clásicos estadounidenses, como la Buster's Bacon Burger y los Pretzel Dogs, junto con favoritos localizados que van desde aperitivos para compartir hasta platos fuertes abundantes, diseñados para satisfacer todos los antojos. DRINK (Beber) – Un dinámico programa de bar con cócteles artesanales, cerveza bien fría y bebidas especiales, creando el ambiente perfecto para reuniones después del trabajo o celebraciones de fin de semana. PLAY (Jugar) – Juegos de arcade de última generación, simuladores y atracciones inmersivas que reúnen a las personas a través de la diversión y la competencia amistosa. La ubicación de Manila presenta una emocionante selección de juegos exclusivos para este mercado, incluidos *Krazy Ball Z, Goatz and Ropes, Water Gun Fun Pixel, Pac-Man Roller, Mega Blaster, Fast and Furious Arcade, Godzilla VR* y *StepManiaX Arcade Deluxe*. WATCH (Ver) – Una experiencia de bar deportivo de última generación con pantallas HD gigantes, convirtiendo a Dave & Buster's en el destino ideal para disfrutar de eventos deportivos locales e internacionales. "Esto es más que una apertura; es un momento decisivo para Dave & Buster's mientras expandimos nuestra presencia en Filipinas", dijo **Antonio Bautista**, Director de Desarrollo Internacional de Dave & Buster's. "Junto con The Bistro Group, estamos creando un centro de entretenimiento único en Manila, donde los invitados pueden comer, beber, jugar y ver todo bajo un mismo techo." Jean Paul Manuud , Presidente de The Bistro Group, añadió: "Dave & Buster's es una marca revolucionaria y estamos orgullosos de traerla a Filipinas. Manila está lista para un lugar que combine gastronomía de clase mundial, juegos de siguiente nivel y la mejor experiencia para ver deportes, todo en un mismo espacio." La apertura de Manila representa el primer paso en un plan de desarrollo de múltiples unidades en todo el país y refuerza el crecimiento internacional de Dave & Buster's, con próximas aperturas planeadas en India, Australia, México y República Dominicana. La marca actualmente opera más de 220 ubicaciones en todo el mundo. Para más información, visite [ www.daveandbusters.com ]( http://www.daveandbusters.com ). title: Common DIY Painting Mistakes to Avoid
summary: Simple But Critical Tips to Help You Get the Perfect Paint Job
body_text: Common DIY Painting Mistakes to Avoid Simple But Critical Tips to Help You Get the Perfect Paint Job You've got the vision. With a brush in your hand, you can see your Pinterest dreams start to come to life. With the last stroke, you take a step back to take in the previous 8 hours of work. The first word you speak is, "Oh no." If you've joined the DIY crusade at any point in your life, you've probably experienced this stomach-dropping moment yourself. Especially if you've tackled a painting project. Plenty of things can go wrong, from drip marks to uneven coats to obvious strokes. Without the proper preparation, these common painting mistakes can quickly sneak in. With the help of our paint experts, we're here to provide some key tips to achieve a successful paint job and avoid the mistakes many DIYers make. Mistake #1: Skipping Prep Work The most common DIY painting mistake our customers make is jumping straight in with the roller and brush without prepping the space. At Craftwork, our painting projects typically take several days because we spend 80% of our time prepping the home. Whether it’s cleaning the walls, patching holes, or using painter’s tape for crisp lines, skipping prep work often leads to a messy, uneven paint finish that doesn’t last. Pro Tip: Move furniture out of the room, and cover floors to prevent damage. Tape all trim, doorways, and window sashes using professional painter's tape . Every surface needs to be lightly sanded using 120 to 150-grit sandpaper. Mistake #2: Using the Wrong Paint for the Surface Not all paints are created equal. A paint that's perfect for your kitchen walls might not work so well in your bathroom, where humidity levels can cause peeling and bubbling if you’re not using moisture-resistant paint. Similarly, exterior surfaces require paints specifically designed to withstand the elements for a long-lasting paint job. Pro Tip: For Cabinetry, we recommend Sherwin-Williams' Gallery Series . For Interior, Sherwin Williams Cashmere is our top choice due to its ability to self-level and help hide minor imperfections, without visible brush or roller marks. Sherwin Williams SuperPaint gives us a tough, weather-resistant finish we love for our exterior projects. Mistake #3: Skimping on the Painting Tools It can be tempting to grab the cheapest paintbrush or roller at the hardware store, but low-quality tools can lead to streaks, uneven coverage, and a frustrating amount of time spent fixing mistakes. Higher-quality brushes and rollers help ensure smooth, even coats and better overall results for any painting job. Pro Tip: Invest in a good angled brush for cutting in and a quality roller for larger surfaces. The right tools make all the difference in delivering a professional-quality paint finish. Mistake #4: Painting in Different Directions Consistency is key when it comes to applying paint. Painting in different directions can create visible brush and roller marks, resulting in an uneven finish that stands out, especially in natural light. Instead of switching directions, stick to a methodical, consistent technique, such as vertical strokes for walls or following the grain of wood for trim. Pro Tip: Maintain consistent pressure with your roller or brush, and keep your strokes even. Paint from the top to the bottom, making a "W" shape, allowing you to catch any drips as you go. Mistake #5: Overloading the Brush or Roller When applying paint, less is more. Overloading the brush or roller leads to drips, splatters, and uneven coats. Many DIYers think they can speed up the process by applying more paint at once, but this often results in a messier, less polished outcome. Follow the instructions on your paint can regarding drying time between coats. Pro Tip: Carve out enough time so you can be patient. We apply multiple thin coats rather than one heavy coat. If you’re unsure of drying times, wait 24 hours. Mistake #6: Skipping Primer Primer isn’t just an extra step—skipping it can lead to uneven coverage, especially when transitioning between dark and light colors, or when painting over surfaces like wood, drywall, or metal. Primer helps the paint adhere better, enhances the final color, and provides a smoother finish. Pro Tip: Use a primer that’s compatible with both your surface and your paint. At Craftwork, we always prime surfaces to ensure the top coat shines at its best and that we avoid common rookie mistakes. Mistake #7: Starting with the Walls It might seem natural to paint the walls first, but this can lead to extra work when it comes time to cut in along the edges or paint trim. Our painters often start with the trim and then move to the ceiling before finishing with the walls. This method allows for easier cleanup and a more polished result. Pro Tip: Paint your room from top to bottom—ceiling, trim, then walls—to avoid drips and ensure clean lines where different surfaces meet. Conclusion: Painting with Precision Tackling a painting project on your own can be rewarding, but it’s easy to fall into common mistakes that DIYers make. From skipping primer to using the wrong paint or rushing through prep work, these errors can turn a fun DIY project into a frustrating mess. However, with the right tools, techniques, and some patience, you can avoid these pitfalls! At Craftwork , we’ve perfected our process, ensuring every paint finish is smooth and flawless. Whether you're updating a room or tackling a larger painting project, our team is here to help in case the DIY doesn't work out.

title: Fractional Hiring
summary: Fractional hiring is redefining the future of work, allowing businesses to access top-tier talent on a part-time or project basis without the costs of full-time roles. This approach offers agility, cost savings, and faster time-to-market, positioning companies to adapt and thrive. For professionals, it means flexibility, diverse projects, and better work-life balance. In a world where remote work is the norm, fractional hiring ensures that businesses stay competitive and innovative.
body_text: Fractional Hiring: The Future of Work In my time studying history at Brown University, one lesson stood out: the pace of change is accelerating. We’ve all felt this with the advancements in adoption of AI the past 18 months. Sam Altman , CEO of OpenAI, highlights that we're approaching an era where billion-dollar companies might be operated by just one or two people. Observing my fellow Y Combinator batchmates and the larger companies I've spoken with, one trend emerges as evidence of us moving in this direction: fractional hiring. What is Fractional Hiring? A New Way to Build Agile Teams Fractional hiring involves engaging professionals on a part-time, contract, or project basis rather than through traditional full-time employment. What started with executive roles has now expanded across all levels, including individual contributors, managers, and specialists. Companies today can access top-tier talent without long-term commitments or the high cost of full-time roles. Much like cloud computing, fractional hiring allows businesses to pay only for what they need. A “Dream Scenario” Example of Fractional Hiring Success Imagine a fast-growing startup launching a new product. They need expertise in marketing, design, and product development to make a significant impact. Instead of lengthy hiring processes, they: Bring in a fractional Chief Marketing Officer to define the go-to-market strategy. Hire a UX designer for a one-month sprint to polish the product interface. Engage a data analyst to measure and optimize the campaign's effectiveness. These experts, each with proven records, execute seamlessly without long onboarding or full-time commitments. The result? They launch within weeks instead of months. Benefits of Fractional Hiring for Companies Fractional hiring offers numerous advantages for businesses looking to stay competitive: Access to Top-Tier Talent: Engage highly specialized professionals with niche expertise on a project basis, allowing you to tap into skills that might be scarce or too costly to maintain in-house full-time. Cost Efficiency: Reduce overhead costs associated with full-time salaries, benefits, and long-term commitments. Pay only for the talent you need, when you need it. Enhanced Agility and Flexibility: Quickly scale your team up or down in response to market changes or project demands without the delays of traditional hiring processes. Accelerated Time to Market: Bring products or services to market faster by leveraging experts who can hit the ground running, minimizing onboarding time. Global Talent Pool Access: Leverage a worldwide network of professionals. Platforms like Pangea.app connect you with talent from over 160 countries, ensuring you find the perfect fit regardless of location. Diverse Perspectives and Innovation: Incorporate fresh ideas and diverse perspectives that fractional professionals bring from their varied experiences across industries. Risk Mitigation: Reduce the risks associated with bad hires. Fractional engagements allow for trial periods to assess fit and performance before considering long-term commitments. Focus on Core Business: Free up internal resources to focus on core business functions while experts handle specialized tasks. The Talent Perspective: Why Professionals Choose Fractional Work Fractional hiring doesn't just benefit companies; it also offers significant advantages to professionals seeking more control over their careers. For many talented individuals, fractional work provides an alternative to traditional employment that aligns better with their personal and professional goals. Fractional work transforms career paths for talent by offering: Flexibility: Choose projects that align with personal passions and strengths, managing workloads that fit their lifestyle. Diverse Experience: Work across multiple industries and companies, enhancing skills and building a versatile résumé. Work-Life Balance: Maintain control over schedules, leading to better work-life integration. Global Opportunities: Collaborate with clients worldwide without geographical limitations, expanding professional networks and cultural understanding. The Rise of Remote Work and Its Impact on Fractional Hiring The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated the shift towards remote work . Tools like Zoom have normalized virtual collaboration, allowing teams to work seamlessly across borders. Fractional hiring fits perfectly into this model, enabling companies to build dynamic, distributed teams that can adapt to the ever-changing business landscape. While many companies are transitioning back to in-person settings for their core teams, the demand for remote fractional roles continues to grow. The pandemic has not only proven the viability of remote work but has also shifted perceptions, reducing the stigma that once surrounded it. Professionals and businesses alike have recognized that productivity and collaboration can thrive outside traditional office environments, especially in specialized, project-based engagements. A Pathway from Fractional to Full-Time Fractional hiring not only offers immediate benefits but also serves as a strategic pathway for long-term growth—both for companies and professionals. This approach allows for a gradual, low-risk transition that can lead to full-time engagements. For companies, engaging talent fractionally provides an opportunity to: Test Compatibility: Evaluate a professional's skills, work ethic, and cultural fit within the organization through real-world projects before committing to a full-time hire. Reduce Hiring Risks: Mitigate the risks and costs associated with traditional hiring processes, such as lengthy recruitment cycles and the potential of a mismatch that could impact team dynamics and productivity. Build Trust and Rapport: Develop a working relationship over time, leading to stronger collaboration and mutual respect. For professionals, fractional work offers the chance to: Explore Opportunities: Experience working with different companies and industries to find the best fit for their skills and career aspirations. Showcase Expertise: Demonstrate their value and impact on a company through tangible results. Negotiate Better Terms: Use proven performance as leverage for negotiating roles, responsibilities, and compensation in a potential full-time position. By allowing both parties to "try before they buy," fractional hiring paves the way for smoother transitions into full-time roles when it makes sense, ensuring alignment of goals and expectations. Conclusion: Build the Future One Fractional Hire at a Time The future of work is adaptable, fast, and driven by people delivering their best where and when needed. Companies that embrace fractional hiring will be better positioned to innovate and thrive in the rapidly changing global economy. ‍

title: La tecnología de RUUF optimiza cada proyecto solar
summary: Cómo la tecnología de RUUF diseña y optimiza cada proyecto solar: de la cotización automática con imagen satelital a la instalación.
body_text: Una pastelería solar Imagina que RUUF es una pastelería. Cada día abre sus puertas sin saber qué van a pedir los clientes: A veces es una sola torta de chocolate para 20 personas. Otras veces son cinco tortas distintas: de frambuesa, de limón, sin azúcar, y cada una para un número diferente de invitados. Y en los días más intensos, llegan pedidos de diez tortas diferentes: algunas de dos pisos, otras con decoraciones frágiles, otras veganas, y todas deben estar listas al mismo tiempo. El problema es que nadie sabe con certeza qué se pedirá mañana. Y no basta con tener harina y azúcar: hay que calcular con precisión materiales, cantidades y el orden de producción para poder cumplir con todas las tortas. En RUUF ocurre lo mismo. Cada proyecto solar es único, porque cada techo, comuna y familia tiene sus propias condiciones. Instalar energía solar no es simplemente “poner paneles solares en un techo”, requiere cálculos exactos de inclinación, cableado, materiales y proyección de consumo a futuro. La pregunta clave: ¿y la tecnología? En las últimas semanas he conversado con devs de distintos lados y hay una pregunta que se repite: ¿dónde está la tecnología en RUUF? Más de una vez me han dicho: “ustedes tienen un equipo tecnológico muy bueno, pero no entiendo por qué” . La gran mayoría de la tecnología en RUUF no está a la vista. Más del 90% de nuestro código vive en el backend , y por lo mismo, pasa desapercibido . Es como la cocina de la pastelería y no el mesón que todos ven . Y por lo mismo, suele pasar desapercibido. Pero en RUUF no programamos por programar. Nos hacemos preguntas concretas: ¿Qué podríamos estar haciendo mejor? ¿Qué podemos automatizar? ¿Dónde está hoy el cuello de botella? Un ejemplo muy claro es el cálculo de materiales que se necesita para cada instalación. Si hoy lo hiciéramos manualmente, necesitaríamos contratar al menos dos personas adicionales dedicadas exclusivamente a esa tarea. Personalmente, no me gustaría ser una de esas personas. El nacimiento de Vlad Acá entra algo clave de nuestra cultura: la colaboración constante entre desarrollo y operaciones. El equipo de operaciones (¡gracias, Pipe! 🙌) definió los inputs (las posibles variables que influyen en qué se necesitará), transformó el problema en cálculos comprensibles y nos ayudó a entenderlo desde el terreno. De ahí en adelante, el desafío fue llevarlo a un sistema: estandarizable, modular y extensible, porque los requisitos y materiales cambian con el tiempo. Implementamos fórmulas de caída de tensión, cálculos de longitud de cableado según tamaño de tableros, selección de fijaciones según tipo de cubierta… Y sí, también nos equivocamos: una vez incluso enviamos a un cliente 25 veces más rieles de aluminio de lo necesario . Lograr llegar a una solución general que funcione para todo tipo de instalación requirió mucho esfuerzo. Fue un proceso largo, de mucho cuestionamiento, toma de decisiones y sufrimiento. Es un sistema muy complejo, donde las fórmulas dependen unas de otras; un error en un cálculo puede afectar los resultados de otros materiales, y comprobar si el resultado es correcto no siempre es fácil. Por esa misma dificultad, tuvimos que desarrollar nuestras propias herramientas que nos faciliten el desarrollo y la comunicación. Herramientas que nos permiten comparar nuestros resultados con los cálculos realizados por el equipo de operaciones, obtener una visión del progreso y tener más claridad sobre qué tipo de instalaciones o materiales requieren mayor desarrollo. Fue un proceso de mucha iteración y colaboración. Partimos desarrollando que funcione para una instalación simple de cinco paneles, luego diez paneles, luego con zanjas, hasta finalmente llegar a instalaciones de clientes reales. Con nuestras pruebas alcanzamos a cubrir un total de 36 casos distintos. De todo ese proceso nació Vlad . Con un set de inputs estándar (tipo de techo, distancias, cadenas solares ( strings ), protecciones, comuna, etc.), Vlad devuelve en milisegundos las cantidades necesarias de materiales para un proyecto. Calcula desde el diámetro de las tuberías hasta si es necesario arrendar andamios. Ejemplo de resultados que retorna Vlad Lo que Vlad habilita Tener a Vlad como base nos ha permitido avanzar mucho más allá del cálculo de materiales. Hoy podemos: Optimizar costos : si las tejas son delicadas, el sistema lo considera automáticamente y sugiere los refuerzos adecuados. Proyectar gastos desde el inicio : incluso cuando alguien completa el formulario en ruuf.cl y obtiene un presupuesto, por detrás ya se ejecutan estos cálculos para estimar gastos reales. Controlar facturas : como los datos son nuestros, podemos validar que lo facturado por proveedores corresponda a lo que efectivamente se compró. Lo que viene Cada mejora tecnológica significa que podemos llegar a más casas, más rápido, y con mejores resultados. Pero sabemos que todavía queda mucho camino por recorrer. Cosas como integrar cargadores de auto eléctrico, expandirnos a la realidad de otros países, identificar más tipos de falla y gestionar el arreglo automáticamente. Vlad es solo uno de los muchos ejemplos de cómo en RUUF usamos la tecnología para mejorar procesos, estandarizar instalaciones y asegurar calidad. Si te interesa participar en un equipo que combina desarrollo tecnológico con impacto real en la descarbonización del planeta , revisa nuestras vacantes abiertas en ruuf.cl/jobs . Todavía tenemos mucho por hacer, muchas más familias a las que llegar y mucha energía limpia por instalar.
